description: KrystalView helps users inspect real website behavior from ChatGPT. It can list recent visitor sessions, drill into session detail, summarize site stats, analyze scroll depth, show live visitors, explain anomalies, inspect funnels, report campaign attribution and ROAS, list browser errors, and retrieve recent analytics notifications.
